rationale: The candidate is a coherent early massing with a legible dominant U-shaped/looping figure and a clear central void, so it plausibly supports neighborhood-living program logic. It responds to the parcel reasonably well, but the mass remains somewhat boxy and the section is not yet especially expressive. The access edge is acknowledged through the open side/void condition rather than sealed frontage, which helps the public threshold reading. The form is coherent across the four views and there is no visible collision problem. It is not yet exceptional, but it satisfies the program enough to pass.
